clips.title: The story
paras: Legging It is a quest focused on clearing a dangerous southern path to protect working peons. Threats along the roadway had frightened the labor force into halting their travels, stalling essential duties. By driving back the dangers, adventurers restore safe passage and enable the workforce to return to their assignments.

Legging It addresses a disruption in local labor operations where peons became too frightened to journey southward. Rather than performing their assigned tasks, the workers refused to risk travel along the road due to looming perils. By intervening to push back threats along the path, travelers restore enough security for overseers to send their crews back to work.

Peons represent the backbone of Horde infrastructure, responsible for timber harvesting, quarrying, and building outposts. Because peons possess little martial prowess, even minor roadside predators or hostile scouts can freeze supply chains. Ensuring that transit corridors remain clear is essential for keeping settlements supplied and productive.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road.
If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, friend. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
